content: Hui-chieh:
We have been heading south.

raw: The guerrillas are hoping to get to as many mines as possible before the extermination plan gets underway to save as many Infected as we can.
content: The guerrillas are hoping to get to as many mines as possible before the extermination plan gets underway to save as many Infected as we can.

raw: The garrison is falling back, and we are pushing further and further ahead.
content: The garrison is falling back, and we are pushing further and further ahead.

raw: To outsiders, it probably looks like we are hunting down the Ursus squads. That couldn't be further from the truth, and it's a nigh impossible task.
content: To outsiders, it probably looks like we are hunting down the Ursus squads. That couldn't be further from the truth, and it's a nigh impossible task.

raw: We are hiding from the Ursus Army while also trying to save the Infected from under their nose.
content: We are hiding from the Ursus Army while also trying to save the Infected from under their nose.

raw: If you ask me why we are doing this, I guess all I can tell you is, 'It's what we are supposed to do.'
content: If you ask me why we are doing this, I guess all I can tell you is, 'It's what we are supposed to do.'

raw: That being said, I can't help but feel that by taking in all these Infected, thus giving the other teams some breathing room, we may be playing into Mr. Patriot's hand.
content: That being said, I can't help but feel that by taking in all these Infected, thus giving the other teams some breathing room, we may be playing into Mr. Patriot's hand.

raw: Patriot might have drawn a line. A line that we dare not to cross.
content: Patriot might have drawn a line. A line that we dare not to cross.

raw: To cross that line is to fight the Ursus garrison head-on—a tall order, it goes without saying. It's either that or keeping ourselves under the radar.
content: To cross that line is to fight the Ursus garrison head-on—a tall order, it goes without saying. It's either that or keeping ourselves under the radar.

raw: In other words, we'll have to leave the tundra, and that means infiltrating the real Ursus territory—their nomadic cities, where all aspects of life are ruled with their iron fist.
content: In other words, we'll have to leave the tundra, and that means infiltrating the real Ursus territory—their nomadic cities, where all aspects of life are ruled with their iron fist.

raw: At that point, the guerrillas put their weapons away until it's time for us to take up arms again.
content: At that point, the guerrillas put their weapons away until it's time for us to take up arms again.

raw: The treatment of the Infected in the cities and ships out in the wild are bound to be even more cruel. I imagine the days that are to come will be very difficult.
content: The treatment of the Infected in the cities and ships out in the wild are bound to be even more cruel. I imagine the days that are to come will be very difficult.

raw: It's not easy to take this step.
content: It's not easy to take this step.

raw: But this is the Northwestern Tundra... There's nothing but snow here.
content: But this is the Northwestern Tundra... There's nothing but snow here.

raw: We can't feed all these mouths with just snow.
content: We can't feed all these mouths with just snow.

raw: [name="Petrova"]  My brothers and sisters, are you okay?!
speaker: Petrova
content: My brothers and sisters, are you okay?!

content: It's good to see all of you in one piece.

speaker: Petrova
content: ...Man, was that battle not a disaster.

speaker: Talulah
content: Thank you, Yeti Squad. It's a pleasure to lead the fight with all of you.

raw: [name="Petrova"]  The pleasure is ours, Talulah. We all think it's very reassuring to fight alongside you. We make a good match. Now I can see why FrostNova trusted you to lead our squad.
speaker: Petrova
content: The pleasure is ours, Talulah. We all think it's very reassuring to fight alongside you. We make a good match. Now I can see why FrostNova trusted you to lead our squad.

content: What's more, the way you use your Arts is getting more ingenious by the day. Blasting flames through the cold air, and detonating that? I don't think I could've come up with that one.

content: Well... those weren't exactly flames. It's hard to explain, so I'll spare you the details.

raw: [name="Petrova"]  I'm sure FrostNova can rest easy knowing she doesn't have to look out for us all the time anymore.

content: I'm sure FrostNova can rest easy knowing she doesn't have to look out for us all the time anymore.

raw: [name="Petrova"]  So, do you think we'll come across any more of those Ursus scum here?
speaker: Petrova
content: So, do you think we'll come across any more of those Ursus scum here?

speaker: Talulah
content: Well, this is one of the cities Ursus was planning on dismantling three years ago.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  The troops here managed to take over the city, probably thanks to corruption or some equally dirty work... As for the original residents... probably either enslaved or driven out.
speaker: Talulah
content: The troops here managed to take over the city, probably thanks to corruption or some equally dirty work... As for the original residents... probably either enslaved or driven out.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  They didn't stand a chance against us, at the very least.

content: Just relatively speaking. Compared to the regular Ursus Army, at least. It's not like Patriot has let you fight any battles that difficult.

raw: [name="Petrova"]  No, he hasn't. It's true. He didn't think we could handle it. But I think we are more than up to the task now, with how well we're getting on.

content: No, he hasn't. It's true. He didn't think we could handle it. But I think we are more than up to the task now, with how well we're getting on.

content: I'm not so sure about that. The real Ursus Army is on a whole other level. This detachment lacks discipline and training... I'm guessing they might not even be technically organized.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  And we just barely had a leg up over these guys because of our tactical planning.
speaker: Talulah
content: And we just barely had a leg up over these guys because of our tactical planning.

raw: [name="Petrova"]  ...So you're saying we've got nothing to celebrate?
speaker: Petrova
content: ...So you're saying we've got nothing to celebrate?

speaker: Talulah
content: No, far from it. We have all the resources we need to survive now.

speaker: Talulah
content: We really needed these supplies. Without them, we won't make it through the winter.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  Besides, the nomadic city may be old and run-down, maybe even too small, but...

content: Besides, the nomadic city may be old and run-down, maybe even too small, but...

content: It's big enough for us.

content: None of us have ever been on a nomadic city before.

content: What's the matter?

content: You can take half of the resources in the city. Hell, take more than that.

content: Just let us keep the city.

content: With the city... we could go anywhere. We could be anywhere in the tundra. The Patrol Unit and the Ursus troops will never find us.

content: So you are saying you don't want to fight anymore?

content: We'll die.

speaker: Infected
content: We're... We're all a little...

content: These people aren't even on the same level as any of the contingents that Patriot's guerrilla squads have faced.

speaker: Infected
content: But we can't do it!

content: Talulah, you aren't going to deny us even this, are you?

speaker: Petrova
content: Okay, what are you people talking about now?

speaker: Infected
content: The Yeti...!

speaker: Infected
content: ...You coldhearted monsters wouldn't understand! Death means nothing to you, not like the rest of us...!

content: You—

content: Talulah...

content: But I won't stand for any insult to our fighters. Apologize to the Yetis right now.

content: Where are you going?

raw: [name="Patriot"]  I really can't know if you have matured or gone soft in that time.

raw: [name="Patriot"]  Someone like that would've been dead long before the fighting even began.

raw: [name="Patriot"]  What's honorable besides reigning victorious and safeguarding the fruits of victory? Triumphing over the enemies you loathe in battle is by its very nature an honor, but that doesn't mean I take pride in my sacrifices.

raw: [name="Patriot"]  If a decision leads to victory and fewer dead comrades, then that's the right decision to make.

raw: [name="Talulah"]  This city is already on its last legs. It's likely been in service for much longer than it was intended. It's not going to last another three years.
